items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. It also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8), stored cross-site scripting, and an admin input validation flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix resolves a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, with attacks starting as early as September 4, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This regular monthly patch addresses eight critical vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and several incorrect authorization flaws. It is important to note that this patch does not include the StyleSmuggler hotfix (CVE-2026-75650).

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This bulletin resolves 7 vulnerabilities, with 5 rated Critical. The most severe, CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1), allows unauthenticated privilege escalation. Another critical flaw, CVE-2026-48416 (CVSS 7.5), enables unauthenticated security feature bypass with high confidentiality impact.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This bulletin resolves 13 vulnerabilities, including eight critical ones. A notable flaw is an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6), publicly known as PolyShell, which can lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source: Detailed Security Update
items.summary: This critical security bulletin addresses several severe vulnerabilities, including a reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVE-2025-47110, CVSS 9.1) that allows malicious admin users to inject executable scripts. Other issues include improper authorization and access control.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This update fixes 15 CVEs, including critical issues related to incorrect authorization, server-side request forgery, uncontrolled resource consumption, and stored cross-site scripting. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This critical security update addresses vulnerabilities that could potentially allow attackers to execute arbitrary code, posing significant risks to e-commerce websites. It also resolves issues leading to privilege escalation, application denial-of-service, and bypassing security features.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This update addresses several critical vulnerabilities, including an improper authentication flaw (CVE-2024-45115) that allows privilege escalation without prior authentication. This was part of the October 2024 patch set.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This crucial security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. The potential consequences include arbitrary code execution, unauthorized file access, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (CosmicSting)
items.summary: This bulletin fixes an XML external entity injection in the REST API (CVE-2024-34102), publicly known as CosmicSting. An unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary files such as env.php and, chained with another bug, execute code. Mass exploitation followed within weeks.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses improper input validation (CVE-2024-20758) enabling arbitrary code execution by an authenticated administrator, plus stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2024-20759). It was published with the 2.4.7 general availability release.

items.title: OS Command Injection in Magento
items.summary: This critical OS command injection flaw (CVSS 9.1) allows arbitrary code execution without user interaction. Threat actors are exploiting it to inject persistent backdoors into e-commerce websites, using crafted layout templates to reinfect servers.

items.title: Improper Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability (CVE-2025-24434) allows a low-privileged actor to escalate privileges without user interaction. Adobe rated it critical due to the ease of exploitation.
